title: Fixed Column and Through-Guide Radial Work Arm
description: One original complete fixed radial work-robot appearance. A continuous faceted ground plinth, tapered pedestal and tall narrow column include an integral lower shoulder and upper end stop. A thick annular sleeve has a genuine full bore with visible space around that column and rests on the complete lower shoulder. A separate chamfered guide over the sleeve has a real horizontal through-passage. One long straight beam runs through it with a lower seat, positive side and top space, a separate rear stop clear of the column and a continuous forward-open U end tool with two integral prongs. Six closed editable meshes and four opaque constant untextured PBR roles; metres, native Z up, front -Y and full horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. Every complete profile and dimension newly authored using generic mesh helpers only. This is not a removed gantry beam, reposed two-link elbow arm, renamed drill head, old table sleeve or end-tool-only variant. One whole prop, no workpiece, scene or independently counted parts. Static visual art only: column, sleeve, radial and guide describe visible geometry, not degrees of freedom, validated movement, trajectory, sliding or rotation, assembly path, fit, grasp, precision, actuation, load, anchoring, stability, manufacture, installation or safety performance.
